content.user_title: Build RAG Ingestion and Vector Search Workflows
content.value_statement: RAG systems can be hard to align across ingestion, vector search, and prompt design. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a concise map of the pipeline.
actual_capabilities: Explains document scanning and MDX cleanup for ingestion.
Describes chunking with 1000 characters and 100 character overlap.
Identifies models/text-embedding-004 as the embedding model.
Documents Qdrant collection settings, including physical_ai_book and cosine similarity.
Explains prompt construction with retrieved context chunks.
Notes personalization fields used to shape system instructions.
limitations: The package contains documentation only, not the referenced backend files.
It does not provide full deployment, authentication, or monitoring guidance.
It does not define evaluation metrics for retrieval quality.
The notes assume Qdrant and one embedding model choice.

use_cases.title: Plan a RAG Ingestion Flow
use_cases.description: Data engineers can map document scanning, cleaning, chunking, embedding, and Qdrant upserts before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Vector Search Setup
use_cases.description: ML engineers can confirm collection name, vector size, similarity metric, and embedding model choices for Qdrant.

use_cases.title: Align Prompt Context Design
use_cases.description: Product teams can understand how retrieved chunks and user background shape personalized responses.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain this RAG pipeline in plain language. Cover ingestion, vector search, prompt construction, and agent flow.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Implementation Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn the RAG pipeline notes into an implementation checklist for a small team. Include dependencies, data flow, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Vector Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the Qdrant vector search design. Identify assumptions about embeddings, vector size, collection naming, and similarity search.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production readiness plan for this RAG pipeline. Include ingestion scheduling, monitoring, data refresh, access controls, and failure handling.

output_examples.output: The system scans documents, removes MDX metadata, splits content into overlapping chunks, embeds each chunk, and stores vectors in Qdrant.
The RAG prompt combines retrieved context with personalization fields, then sends the assembled prompt through an agent wrapper.
Add source tracking, retry handling, evaluation sets, and monitoring before using the pipeline in production.

best_practices: Confirm the embedding model and vector size before creating the Qdrant collection.
Validate chunk quality with representative documents before bulk ingestion.
Keep personalization fields explicit and avoid including sensitive user details.
anti_patterns: Running ingestion on unreviewed documents without checking data quality.
Changing embedding models without rebuilding or migrating the vector collection.
Adding personal background fields to prompts without consent or data controls.

faq.question: What does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It documents a RAG pipeline with ingestion, MDX cleaning, chunking, embeddings, Qdrant search, prompt construction, and agent flow.

faq.question: Does it include runnable source code?
faq.answer: No. The package contains guidance in SKILL.md and references project files outside the skill package.

faq.question: Which vector database is described?
faq.answer: It describes Qdrant with cosine similarity and a 768-dimension vector setup.

faq.question: Which embedding model is referenced?
faq.answer: It references models/text-embedding-004 for generating document embeddings.

faq.question: Can Claude or Codex use this for implementation planning?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can use the notes to plan or review a RAG implementation.

faq.question: What should I verify before production use?
faq.answer: Verify data permissions, chunk quality, collection settings, refresh strategy, monitoring, and user data handling.
